issue.title: Clarify -ipcbind syntax when using max-connections with the default Unix socket
issue.body:
The -ipcbind option supports the default Unix socket address unix and per-address connection limits using the max-connections option.

The examples for the connection-limit syntax use -ipcbind=unix:,max-connections=8, with a colon after unix. It may be worth clarifying whether this colon is required when adding socket options to the default Unix socket address.

Is -ipcbind=unix:,max-connections=8 the intended syntax for setting a connection limit on the default socket, and is the colon required to distinguish the socket address from the following options?

If so, documenting this distinction in the -ipcbind help text could make the syntax easier to understand.

Related PR

https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35037

I have not independently tested the alternative syntax. This report is asking for clarification rather than asserting that a confirmed bug exists.
